name: OpenVDB DDA
aliases: Digital Differential Analyzer specialized for OpenVDB grids
definition: A Digital Differential Analyzer specialized for OpenVDB grids, conceptually similar to Bresenham's line algorithm applied to a 3D Ray intersecting OpenVDB nodes or voxels.
summary: OpenVDB DDA is a ray traversal algorithm that iterates through every OpenVDB node or voxel boundary along a ray path using a fixed step-size, unlike Hierarchical DDA which skips empty space.
